answer_4.quote: A team of domain experts, four upper-year law students at a highly selective law school, annotated selections from court opinions as formal, grand, or lacking statutory interpretation.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation task asked each annotator to assign one of three labels, 'formal,' 'grand,' or 'none,' to each paragraph. A fourth label, 'low confidence,' could be added... inter-rater reliability using Krippendorff's alpha... discussions led to the revision of our codebook.
